mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and rise in unemployment rate signals an economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of declining HOUST and rising UNRATE fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases (i.e., returns are positive in >60% of instances when both conditions hold).

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightening regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where UNRATE is below 4.0% and declining.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1400.0 thousand units signal a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where HOUST falls below 1400.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls over the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS declines by at least 50,000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and GDP growth signals an economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where INDPRO and GDPC1 both decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), a decline in the inflation rate signals a potential monetary policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where CPIAUCSL is above 3.0% and declining.
